title: Moment tail bound
statement: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ and let $q,c>0$. Under the uniform measure on the Boolean cube, $\Pr(|f(x)|\geq c)\leq(\|f\|_q/c)^q$, where $\|f\|_q=(\mathbb E|f|^q)^{1/q}$.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\bbr$ and $q,c>0$, uniform probability satisfies $\Pr[|f|\ge c]\le(\|f\|_q/c)^q$, where $\|f\|_q=(\E|f|^q)^{1/q}$.
